title: Optimize Your Sampling: Tuned Diffusion Sampling with Bayesian Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2608.18040v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sampling from a diffusion model typically requires many forward passes through a large neural network, making generation computationally expensive. While much work has focused on efficient solvers and samplers, comparatively little attention has been paid to selecting the sampling timesteps themselves. A recent line of work optimizes theoretically derived surrogates for sample quality rather than the quality metric itself. We propose Optimizing Your Sampling (OYS), which instead treats timestep selection as a black-box optimization problem, optimizing the target metric directly with Bayesian optimization. OYS outperforms both the default schedules and those of Align Your Steps on text-to-image generation, and improves over the default schedules on inpainting and other image tasks, in both quantitative and human evaluations. translated_title: 优化你的采样：基于贝叶斯优化的调谐扩散采样
translated_abstract: 从扩散模型中进行采样通常需要多次通过大型神经网络进行前向传播，这使得生成过程计算成本高昂。尽管已有大量工作专注于高效求解器和采样器，但对采样时间步选择本身的关注相对较少。近期一系列工作优化了理论上推导的样本质量替代指标，而非直接优化质量指标本身。我们提出了“优化你的采样”（OYS）方法，该方法将时间步选择视为一个黑箱优化问题，通过贝叶斯优化直接优化目标指标。OYS在文本到图像生成任务中优于默认调度和“对齐你的步骤”方法，并在图像修复及其他图像任务中相较于默认调度有所改进，这一点在定量评估和人工评估中均得到验证。OYS无需额外训练，适用于蒸馏模型，并同时提升了简单和复杂采样器的性能。
tldr: 本文提出OYS方法，通过贝叶斯优化直接优化采样时间步选择，无需训练即可提升扩散模型生成质量，在文本到图像及图像修复等任务中超越现有调度方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes OYS, a method that uses Bayesian optimization to directly optimize sampling timestep selection, improving diffusion model generation quality without additional training, outperforming existing schedules in text-to-image and inpainting tasks.
